test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper( Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Determine the smallest number which when divided by 12,16, 20, 25 and 30 leaves the same remainder 3 in each case.
solution:
**Concept used:**

When smallest number asked, which when divided by a, b, c leaves the same remainder R in each case, that number is LCM[a, b, c] + R

**Calculation:**

∴ Smallest number which when divided by 12,16, 20.25 and 30 leaves the same remainder 3 in each case is LCM[12,16, 20.25, 30] + 3

= 1200 + 3

= 1203
